items.title: The name
items.text: Bought by Systemax for **$14.0M** in 2009, retired in 2012, sold for **$2.0M** in 2015 and relaunched as a website in 2018.[^21][^22][^23][^36] An online shop was still trading under the logo in October 2026.[^37]

items.title: CarMax
items.text: The used-car chain separated in 2002 had 256 stores and **$25.88B** in sales in fiscal 2026, about twice Circuit City’s best year.[^12][^26][^1]

items.title: The Canadian stores
items.text: The Source by Circuit City was sold to Bell Canada. The sale closed on July 1, 2009 and the U.S. estate received $15M for trademarks and a sourcing subsidiary.[^17]

items.title: The company
items.text: The estate moved into a liquidating trust on November 1, 2010 and the last directors resigned.[^18] Shareholders were told to expect nothing; general unsecured creditors, an estimated 0% to 13.5%.[^15][^17]

items.title: The employees
items.text: About 39,600 at the filing. On January 16, 2009 the board approved a plan to end the employment of all of them.[^17][^15]

items.title: Best Buy
items.text: The rival reported $41.7B in revenue for fiscal 2026.[^25]

blocks.title: Who has owned the Circuit City name
blocks.subtitle: Three owners in the seventeen years since the stores closed.
